title.zh: 自10月30日起，商业账户将被视为同意Meta抓取其网站内容
title.en: Business accounts will consent to Meta scraping their websites Starting Oct. 30

current_state.zh: 据Nieman Lab报道，Meta于10月30日生效的新商业条款允许其抓取与其商业用户（包括新闻出版商）相关的网站，并利用这些外部内容来开发、改进、研究和训练AI。
current_state.en: Meta's new business terms, effective October 30, allow it to scrape websites associated with its business users, including news publishers, and use that outside content to develop, improve, research, and train AI, according to Nieman Lab reporting.

updates.title_zh: 自10月30日起，商业账户将被视为同意Meta抓取其网站内容
updates.title_en: Business accounts will consent to Meta scraping their websites Starting Oct. 30
updates.what_changed_zh: Meta于10月30日生效的更新商业条款将把商业账户持有者的继续使用视为同意Meta抓取其网站并授予其内容许可，法律专家称，对于并不拥有被视作授予的权利的出版商而言，这一变更在法律上存疑。
updates.what_changed_en: Meta's updated commercial terms, effective October 30, will treat business account holders' continued use as consent to Meta scraping their websites and a license to their content, a change legal experts say is legally questionable for publishers who don't own the rights they are deemed to grant.

updates.current_state_en: Meta's updated commercial terms, effective October 30, will treat business account holders' continued use as consent to Meta scraping their websites and a license to their content, a change legal experts say is legally questionable for publishers who don't own the rights they are deemed to grant.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Meta's updated commercial terms, effective October 30, will treat business account holders' continued use as consent to Meta scraping their websites and a license to their content, a change legal experts say is legally questionable for publishers who don't own the rights they are deemed to grant.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Meta's updated commercial terms, effective October 30, will treat business account holders' continued use as consent to Meta scraping their websites and a license to their content, a change legal experts say is legally questionable for publishers who don't own the rights they are deemed to grant.

updates.title_zh: Meta新条款可能允许其免费利用新闻网站训练AI
updates.title_en: Meta’s new terms may allow it to train AI on news sites for free
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道指出，这些条款还允许Meta利用外部内容来“开发、改进、研究”和“训练”AI，包括在新闻出版商网站上，而不仅仅是抓取和授权内容。
updates.what_changed_en: New reporting specifies the terms also allow Meta to use outside content to "develop, improve, research," and "train" AI, including on news publisher sites, not just scrape and license content.
updates.current_state_zh: 据Nieman Lab报道，Meta于10月30日生效的新商业条款允许其抓取与其商业用户（包括新闻出版商）相关的网站，并利用这些外部内容来开发、改进、研究和训练AI。
updates.current_state_en: Meta's new business terms, effective October 30, allow it to scrape websites associated with its business users, including news publishers, and use that outside content to develop, improve, research, and train AI, according to Nieman Lab reporting.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Meta's new business terms may allow it to scrape and train AI on websites associated with its business users, including news publishers, starting October 30.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Meta's new business terms may allow it to scrape and train AI on websites associated with its business users, including news publishers, starting October 30.
